title: Willow Glen：成熟街区与房屋个性
title_en: Willow Glen: established streets and homes with character
intro: Willow Glen 在 Downtown 西南，大致夹在 I-280、SR-87 和 Los Gatos Creek 之间，大家日常说的 Willow Glen 多指 Lincoln Avenue 两侧的老街区。这里的特色在于成熟住宅街区、不同年代的建筑风格，以及 Lincoln Avenue 周边的商业生活设施：二十世纪上半叶的 bungalow、Tudor 和 Spanish Revival 老房与战后的 ranch 平房并存，餐馆、咖啡店和日常小店沿街排开。房屋个性差异大，也是这个市场最明显的特点。
intro_en: Willow Glen sits southwest of Downtown, roughly between I-280, SR-87 and Los Gatos Creek, and locally the name usually means the older streets on either side of Lincoln Avenue. It is known for established residential streets, homes from many eras, and the shops and restaurants around Lincoln Avenue. Early twentieth-century bungalows, Tudors and Spanish Revival homes stand alongside postwar ranch houses, and that variety between individual homes is the defining feature of this market.
buyer: 同在 Willow Glen，不同房屋可能在建筑年代、地块形状、停车条件、装修品质和步行便利性上差异明显。老房还应关注地基、排水、白蚁、许可记录和保险成本。
buyer_en: Within Willow Glen, homes can differ widely in age, lot shape, parking, quality of work and walkability. With older homes, also look at the foundation, drainage, termites, permit history and insurance cost.
seller: Willow Glen 的房屋不适合只用统一每平方英尺价格比较。历史风格、房屋维护、户外空间及临近主干道等因素，都需要在定价分析中体现。
seller_en: A single price per square foot does not work well here. Historic character, upkeep, outdoor space and proximity to busy streets all need to show up in the pricing analysis.
